about.title: About Omar Emad
about.summary: I'm Omar Emad, a Front End Developer and Full Stack Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 3+ years of hands-on experience building responsive, user-friendly web and mobile applications. As a React expert and Next.js developer, I turn design concepts into seamless, high-performance digital experiences, and as a React Native specialist I ship cross-platform mobile apps. I write clean, efficient, maintainable code and stay current with modern best practices in web and mobile development. I have strong time-management skills, freelanced for over a year, completed a 4-month on-site internship at Goo-Wed Software in Giza, and worked 6 months full-time at Dr.Code Software in Giza, delivering high-quality projects on time and collaborating effectively with clients and teams.
